# Alex Britton

> Personal site of Alex Britton, an engineer. Co-founder of altr (altrwork.com), a
> Tampa-based AI consulting and enablement firm working with teams nationwide, and
> forward deployed engineer at Driveline Baseball. Builds MCP servers, AI agents,
> workflow automation and data pipelines, with most of the altr work in commercial
> real estate.

altr (lowercase, altrwork.com) is not ALTR, the data security company at altr.com.
Alex co-founded altr with Jarred Robidoux and leads its engineering. Mechanical
engineering degree, Embry-Riddle.

## Built at altr

- [CRE Harness](https://altrwork.com/impact-real-estate-property-intelligence.html): property address to a branded broker opinion of value (BOV) from public record
- [Florida county records MCP server](https://altrwork.com/impact-cre-county-records-connector.html): Hillsborough, Pinellas, Pasco and Polk property records inside Claude, OAuth sign-in
- [mortr](https://altrwork.com/mortr.html): CRE CRM sharing one store with the MCP server
- [Manhattan office condo registry](https://altrwork.com/impact-manhattan-office-condo-registry.html): ACRIS, Tax Map and DOF roll joined into a Claude Desktop extension
- [spARK Labs remote MCP server](https://altrwork.com/impact-spark-labs-mcp.html): four operations platforms behind one Cloudflare Workers endpoint
- [BeBrief Codex enablement](https://altrwork.com/impact-bebrief.html): review agents, remote agents and MCP tools in a full-stack team's build
- [MCP servers on Cloudflare Workers](https://altrwork.com/impact-cloudflare-workers-architecture.html): the deployment pattern behind the above

## Other projects

- DL SQL MCP: MCP server for natural language queries over Driveline biomechanics databases
- Elbow torque EMG prediction, YOLOv8 ball detection, multi-camera 3D pose estimation (Driveline)
- [Sweepr](https://github.com/abritton2002/sweepr): keeps repo docs in sync with code
- [BeBrief](https://flybebrief.com/): preflight briefing app for general aviation pilots
